inspiration: Spell as data row: caster animation, projectile, target effect, buildup phase, repeating pulse, radius and resist (source/tools/observer-model-inspection/spells.csv:1). Shape for specials.
Named timed phases for a siege-style telegraph: load start, load end, fire start, fire end, release point (source/tools/observer-model-inspection/siege.csv:2). Shape for boss wind-ups.
Summon announced by a glow in the hand during cast time, using a stock model with a private skin (tools/pet-art/README.md:30). Shape for encounter cues.
Defensive buff drawn as a tinted overlay tied to the buff (tools/pet-art/README.md:30). Shape for readable buffs at 375 wide.
Area blast effect as a ground telegraph then burst (tools/pet-art/README.md:4). Shape for AoE telegraphs.

Monster catalogue as separate columns for body, head, skin set, sound set, scale, height, effects and combat anim set (source/tools/observer-model-inspection/monsters.csv:2). Shape for catalogue fields.
Zones and regions as XML data rows (source/server/GameServer/scripts/dbupdater/insert/Zones.xml:5). Shape for zones as data.

briefs.label: wind-up siege
briefs.why: a long, readable telegraph with named phases so the player can dodge the release
briefs.keep: timed phases with a release point; a readable load bar
briefs.change: our own timings, a different silhouette (not a siege engine), our own colour story

briefs.label: buildup pulse ward
briefs.why: a spell that builds, then pulses on a clock, so the player learns the rhythm
briefs.keep: buildup then repeating pulse; a radius that shows
briefs.change: our own pulse rate in zone data, an aura of glyphs instead of a dome

briefs.label: crimson ward overlay
briefs.why: a buff that reads as a shield at a glance without hiding the hero
briefs.keep: a tinted overlay tied to the buff and a short cast
briefs.change: a different tint family (cold glass plates, not blood) and a different outline

briefs.label: hand-glow summon
briefs.why: a summon that is announced before it lands
briefs.change: our own glow colour and a rune ring instead of a hand

briefs.label: dark burst area
briefs.why: a dark area blast that marks the ground before it hits
briefs.keep: an area ring telegraph, then the burst
briefs.change: our own ring shape, a different burst form, our own sound cue
